text: Replenishable Contingent Financing: The program allows for up to two replenishments within five years, maintaining liquidity for successive shocks. City-Level Parametric Insurance: A voluntary scheme for cities to enable quick payouts based on predefined hazard triggers. Integration of State-Owned Enterprises: Involves national SOEs in disaster risk management, recognizing their role in infrastructure and service continuity. Anticipatory Response Focus: Shifts from reactive to proactive disaster management, emphasizing planning and risk reduction.

metadata.solution_name: Second Disaster Resilience Improvement Program (Second DRIP)
